versions.changelog:
Initial release of iClick iOS automation skill

- Introduces iClick automation skill for iOS 15+ devices, supporting no-jailbreak device monitoring and RPA controls.
- Provides detailed usage documentation and command examples for device state checks, screen capture, touch/click actions, system operations, text input, pointer and keyboard operations.
- Includes privacy protection and best practice guidelines for automation via command-line (node server.js).
- Offers API scenarios for media file handling, app launching, recent app management, and screen actions.
- Supplies skill icon for use in reports or error messages.
